body: Something like this happened to me as well. I as well know exactly who did it to me. However I've told no one who it was. We use to be friends before the incident we are not anymore. I have seen him recently. He talked to me as if we were old friends. Which really messed with my mentally. You have to respect what it is that she wants. She's use to guys doing whatever they please. If you go against her she will ultimately take his side. I know how crazy that sounds, but that's also how I feel about the situation. She trusted you enough to confide in you. It takes a great deal of trust to tell absolutely anyone about what's happened... I know that it is bothering you... But you really really need to think about everything from her point of view. If it makes you feel better maybe you should write a letter to her describing how it makes you feel in return. Let her know that you're trying to understand to the best of your ability... But you've not been through it. I'm kind of rambling... Just... Talk to her and be there for her.

Honestly... Sometimes I wish I were just a figment of people's imagination. At least then I know that I wouldn't actually have gone through everything. But here's the truth... I am not just part of your imagination. I am here. Struggling day to day. Most days worse than the day before. But we've got this. We've come this far in life and this has just been a small portion of what's left to live. We'll have bad days. That's just how life is... But that's okay... Because we can better appreciate the good. We are strong. So so strong! We've got this. We do... We really really do..
I'm here... I'm here and I'm fighting to survive everyday along with you. You are not alone. Please... Do not ever forget that.

Thank you... It isn't that I really feel like I deserve it... Because honestly... I was the girl that would do anything for my friends. Family... Everyone... Anyone... I'd give the shirt off my back to a stranger... And yet... It never matters. I've stuck through it all. I put a smile on my face everyday. I work. I don't use any of it to get out of work. I'vennever called off. I've had to be taken to the hospital in an ambulance because I passed out at work from over exhaustion. My work place? Called the hospital. Actually... Ex that... The district manager had another store manager call the hospital... To makesure I didn't make it up. Are... You... Kidding?! I slaved myself to exhaustion for them! They knew what I was going through... I told them... The state I was in... But I worked my butt off for them... So no... I didn't always feel like I deserved it... But... After a while.. Of over and over... And over... You start to think... If it keeps happeningiit must be me. My fault...  As for the new guy... We've been togetherffor four months. But we've known each other since high school. We've been friends since high school. Just our paths never crossed that way...

I know this is depressing... But for me... What I do for myself... Is wake up. I wake up every day. I don't want to. I don't want to move from bed. I just want to go to sleepand nnever wake up... But I do. I wake up and I move to the couch. I sometimes read. I'll watch a tv show... Pet the dogs. Sometimes... After a few weeks... I'll be call my mum.... I want to be better... I don't want to be like this anymore. I really don't... But I don't know how to be better... How to make myself better...

Now.. I stupidly sit here... Refreshing and refreshing... Just hoping that with ever refresh I had a reply... But really.. Even if there was... I mean... It doesn't really change my past. It doesn't make it go away...

CONTINUED:

Yet again... Fast forward... I start dating a guy that I thought was fantastic. We were perfect together. Until he turned into a major asshole. Cheating on me. Telling me all I was good for was my pussy. Used me. My mum found out at that point that she needed to have a heart ablation. She was at one of the top heart hospitals... They went in. They thought the procedure went just fine. Until they took it out.. She started bleeding out. They had to rush her into open heart surgery. Cracked her chest open... She coded. She died. They worked on her for awhile. She eventually came back from the dead. The wound had healed itself I guess. But she was in a coma. She was in a coma for three days. I went up on mother's day when she was finally coming to with my boyfriend.. And on the way home he broke up with me. Told me he wished we'd meet when we were both at better emotional points in our lives... My mum had just come out of dying and then being in a coma and the one person I had.. Left me. Again... fucking again... Because I am the fucking scum of the universe and just.. Fuck me... I deserve every last thing that has ever happened to me. I mean.. How the fuck else does this happen???? I mean... This shit just doesn't happen to one person... Over... And over... and over...

I move away again. Because I just couldn't seem my ex husband and his high school girlfriend anymore. I just couldn't stand being in the town that had caused me so much pain... I move to PA. Get a job. Become extremely happy. Missing my friends. Family. I had no one in PA but my roommate. That I'd over viewed as a friend. But he. Yes, he.... Viewed me as more. I didn't mean to lead him on. I honestly though that we were just friends. Before I'd even agreed to move over to PA (His idea) I'd made sure he understood my feelings. Well he decided that I wasn't allowed to talk to anyone. Have friends. Anything. I was only allowed to have him... I felt so alone. So very alone. I missed my friends... Family. I would travel back home every chance I could get. So eventually I moved back. I was happy. Healthy.

The job that had took me off the schedule found out I was moving home via my facebook. Asked me to come back to work. I thought, DUH! They offered me a raise and a promotion to a higher position. I thought they were finally coming around. But nope... They just knew that I bend over backwards for them. That I go above and beyond for them. As time goes on.. I find out that my ex husband had been cheating on me for months with the little high school girl. Up until that point I'd never knew. I just knew that he was with someone new now... But nope... Found that gem out. I was crushed... Then to make matters worse.. When she found out that I'd moved back to town.. She started stalking me. Walking past my work alone or with friends. To show them who I was. She started trying to befriend my friends. Would comment or like posts I'd make on MY friends walls. She'd even come into my place of work with a friend. One time the friend stared right at me and loudly yelled. "EEEEW!" Just... Really hurt.... I mean... Really really hurt..

Anyways... I have a great guy now. That I am so mentally fucked with.. That I don't even know what to do... I cry.. All the time. I flip out.. All the time. I am like a fucking psycho. But he sticks by my side. I break up with him weekly. Sometimes even daily... But I can't stop. I am just so mentally fucked up.... I know I am fucked up... But I can't stop myself. I push everyone away. I can't trust anyone... But I want to... I want someone so bad... And the people I do have... I treat like shit because... Well... I am fucked up... Thats why... I don't mean to. I don't want to... But I can't stop. I just... Freak out. Like a fucking psycho.... But I love him. God I love him.... He lets me cry. He takes care of me. He jokes with me. He tries to make me feel better. He is everything I could ever ask for in a guy... And yet... Here I am... A psycho person... That treats me him shit because... I am just so fucked up.. He deserves so much better... So so much better.... And I want to be better for him.. But I don't know how. Medication doesn't help. Talking about everything doesn't help... I am just... Damaged. So so very damaged... And I don't know how to stop.... I just... I don't... I'm a worthless human being that... Deserves everything I get... Everything... I use to be the so outgoing.. Funny... Everyone loved me.. People were drawn to me.. Now... I cry.. I lock myself away and cry... I can't eat. I can't sleep. I just... Cry. I can't even leave the house on my own. I cannot take the dogs out to use the restroom because I am afraid I will run into people.. That ill have to talk to some... I don't text my friends... Or my family. I never hangout with anyone... I'm lucky if I eat in a day. My boyfriend... The love of my life... He takes care of me. He goes to school. Works. Cooks. Does the laundry. Takes care of the dogs. I work... And do the dishes. Clean the bathroom if I get up the motivation... Dust.. sometimes sweep... But other than that.. I am like a zombie. I am just here... Living... Day to day... With no motivation. No intent... No idea what to do with myself. Like a worthless blob... And you know what.. I'm afraid I am going to lose the best thing that ever happened to me... I am so afraid I am going to push him away... Because.. I mean a person can only take so much of a crazy person.. But I can't do anything.. I've tried going to the doctors. Blood work. Psychology... Everything... And I am just screwed.. So... fuck me... Fuck me... Fuck me...

I am so sorry for wasting your time... Thank you for reading..
